$comment: Approved deltas between Design HTML v1.2 and the build (Sprint 0002 A4). Each entry cites the PRD/CR/plan line that approves it. Only a human may add entries; the parity runner exempts exactly what is listed and reports everything else.

deltas.text: We'll email you a one-time code and your receipt
deltas.reason: Transactional email notice under the email field; the prototype hides #identHelp until an error.
deltas.cite: PRD v3.4 §4.5 Tier 0 (D35); SPRINT-0002 U1 'approved delta'

deltas.reason: Transactional-SMS notice under the mobile field and the unchecked marketing opt-in row; absent from v1.2.
deltas.cite: CR-09; PRD D32b, D37, §4.5; SPRINT-0002 U6

deltas.reason: Required Mobile field under Your info when the recognised person has no mobile on file (not rendered for the m@m.com twin, so no pixel effect in the loop).
The Pay Page hosted frame (or TestCardPanel with hooks) replaces the mocked card fields; internals masked, wrapper bounds and neighbouring spacing compared.
deltas.cite: CR-03, CR-04; PRD D44; SPRINT-0002 §Parity loop masks

deltas.reason: Static location label: same text and box, rendered without aria-haspopup / listbox semantics.
deltas.cite: SPRINT-0002 interview decision 'static location label'; intent reconciliation row Header/nav

deltas.reason: Retry / error affordances (session failure, 503 lookup retry, embed load failure) exist only in error states outside the eleven parity states.
Sprint 0001 wallet-retry alert for a failed save; not reachable in the parity runs (saves succeed).

The build defaults the date to club-local today, so the prototype's blank-date help string 'Choose the day you'll visit…' is never rendered; the prototype driver sets #day to the same day before capture.
deltas.cite: CR §D 'Date selector — confirmed correct'; SPRINT-0002 interview 'date defaults to club-local today'

deltas.reason: Refunds paragraph follows PRD D15/D22 ('Refunds: none online. Any refund is at the club's discretion, in club.') instead of v1.2's 'Full refund any time before the first valid day'.
deltas.cite: PRD v3.4 D15, D22; SPRINT-0002 §Consent model

deltas.reason: At 375 px the prototype tab row overflows its 375 px container (padding 16 px + four tabs); the build clips the same row with overflow-x auto. Only width is exempt; text, font and colours are compared.
deltas.cite: SPRINT-0002 C8a 'v1.2 tab-row media rule'; BROWSER-QA P1-6 (no horizontal overflow)
